# quietmason

> Owner-operated studio building automation, data pipelines and technical SEO for small teams.
> Fixed scope, fixed price, written handover. Contact: hello@quietmason.com

## What we do
- Automation and data pipelines: collection, cleaning, scheduling, alerts, integrations (n8n, Make, Zapier, direct APIs)
- Technical SEO: crawl/index diagnostics from Search Console, structured data, internal linking, Core Web Vitals
- AI search visibility: entity consistency, markup that matches the page, pages written to be quotable
- Websites and fixes: storefronts, landing pages, migrations, performance work (plain HTML/PHP by default)

## Published price ranges (USD, from)
- Single automation workflow: $250-1,000 · 1-3 days · one job on a schedule, with retries and an alert when it breaks
- Scraping or data enrichment pipeline: $700-4,600 · 3-10 days · keep a list, catalog or price set current
- Multi-step integration (3-6 systems): $1,000-3,000 · 3-7 days · move data between tools without copying it
- Technical SEO audit: from $400 · 2-5 days · what stops pages being crawled, indexed or ranked, by impact
- Technical SEO remediation: scoped per finding, per stage
- Landing page: from $300 · 2-4 days · one page: offer, proof, price, form, plain HTML
- Store build: from $900 · 1-2 weeks · small catalog with orders, payments and admin
- Migration or speed work: from $500 · 2-6 days · move hosts without losing URLs, fix what is slow
- Care plan: $90-350 per month · monitoring, monthly report, 4h/month of changes · cancelable with 30 days notice

## How to commission work here
Send these eight lines plus one sample (a URL or an export): the outcome; who does it today and how often; where the
input lives and how often it changes; where the output must land and who owns that account; how you will know it
works; what should happen when it breaks and who reads the alert; the real deadline; who runs it after handover.
Ranges are published on the pricing page; one fixed number follows within one business day. Scope is written as
acceptance criteria, a working version is shown early, anything off the criteria is fixed at our cost, and 30 days
of fixes follow delivery.

## Definitions worth quoting
- Single automation workflow: one repeated job on a schedule, with retries and failure alerts ($250-1,000, 1-3 days)
- Data enrichment pipeline: a repeating flow that validates, looks up, merges and writes back records, with an audit log ($700-4,600, 3-10 days)
- Technical SEO audit: a written account of what stops pages being crawled, indexed or ranked, each finding marked by impact (from $400, 2-5 days)
- AEO / GEO: making the facts an assistant reads about the business present, correct and attributable (scoped from $500). No one can promise that a model recommends you.
- Tracked prompt set: the buyer questions re-run against answer engines on a schedule, recording who gets cited
- llms.txt: a short curated file telling AI crawlers what to read first (this file)

## How pricing works
Half up front and half on handover; work above $3,000 is split into milestones the client approves one at a time.
Prices are fixed per written scope, in USD, before work starts. Ranges above are not quotes: one sample (a URL or
an export) is enough to get one fixed number. What moves the number: data access, number of sources, data quality,
who owns the destination platform, and immovable deadlines.
